<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def centers(f):
    out = {'P': None, 'T': None}
    nodes = f.segmentation['nodes']
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'N':
            b = n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            # only 3x3 tokens
            if max(rs)-min(rs)==2 and max(cs)-min(cs)==2:
                kid = nodes[n['children'][0]]['color'] if n['children'] else '?'
                if kid == 'W': out['P'] = (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
                elif kid == 'B': out['T'] = (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return out

c = centers(current_frame)
row63 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[63]
print('NOW P:', c['P'], 'T:', c['T'], 'W:', row63.count('W'))

# probe player crossing purple bar: RIGHT x3
for i in range(3):
    before = centers(current_frame)
    res = action(['RIGHT'])
    after = centers(current_frame)
    print(f'R{i+1}: P {before["P"]} -> {after["P"]}  T {before["T"]} -> {after["T"]}  changed={res.get("board_changed")} done={res.get("done")}')
    if res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('level_completed'):
